articles.title: BAAC and GIZ launch THB 5.3 billion financial package to support 40,000 Thai rice farmers transitioning to climate-smart rice farming
articles.mainIdea: BAAC and GIZ launch THB 5.3 billion financial package to support 40,000 Thai rice farmers transitioning to climate-smart rice farming
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: BAAC and GIZ launch THB 5.3 billion financial package to support 40,000 Thai rice farmers transitioning to climate-smart rice farming. A new THB 5.3 billion initiative empowers 40,000 Thai rice farmers to fight climate change through low-interest loans and sustainable farming subsidies.Bangkok, Thailand, Feb. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives (BAAC), in collaboration with Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), has launched climate-smart subsidy and low-interest loan schemes under the Thai Rice GCF Project, with a total budget of over THB 5.3 billion.
